ref: #48 owner decision Q4: numeric compares decimals (ADR-0005's xs:decimal lexical form); #2 §4 sort: "within the existing or set context", stable, numeric or lexicographic (case-sensitive or not), ascending or descending [SAP✓ STD]
note: numeric, ascending: -1, .25, +0.5, 1.50, 1.5, " 2 ", 9, 10 and 1., 007, 7. 1.50 and 1.5 are equal and keep their input order, as do 007 and 7; " 2 " is 2, as the xs:decimal cast collapses whitespace; each value keeps its own spelling. Lexicographic would put 10 before 9. R1 joins the contexts S1 keeps, so All shows each context's order in turn. Observe in SAP PO (#33).
